headline: Markolines Pavement Technologies shares AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine corporate filing detailing the outcome of shareholder resolutions. Retail investors holding the stock can review the approved resolutions for corporate governance insights. The disclosure is part of standard regulatory compliance for listed companies.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on stock price.
